jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Transform the supplied game map style into ONE COMPLETE SQUARE GROUND TILE for Unity Tilemap, not a whole map. The reference is only the tissue palette and pixel-art style.
The ENTIRE square canvas IS one single grid block, filled edge-to-edge by an opaque top-down tissue floor. Target artwork is a logical 128x128 pixel tile; it may be delivered enlarged, but every contour must use crisp regular square clusters, 2-3 flat shade bands, limited colors and clean stepped curves. Absolutely no transparent area, floating chunk, isometric platform, separated border strip, UI frame, bevel around the square, soft focus or photorealism.
This is a small tile the player can paint directly as one cell with Unity Tilemap. Make the texture legible at 128px, with a few medium-size simple shapes, a compact readable pixel-art language and no fine noise. Match the original cheerful warm peach/coral cell-world, not ordinary soil, stone, grass or dungeon bricks.
Use a COMMON flat warm salmon-peach background #F5A58D. Keep the outer 8 logical pixels on all four sides this identical flat background color, no border line and no detail crossing the tile edge. The center texture ends naturally before this flat connector area. All three sample tile types share these exact four edge colors for mixing.
Strict 90-degree top-down, flat walkable floor, no perspective side face or cast shadow. No tower socket, core objective, enemy, fixed route, arrows, text, numbers, collage, grid guide or other tile. ONE complete full-square image only, fully opaque.
Tile type 1 — plain soft tissue floor. Across the middle place three broad irregular peach cell impressions, with one simple angular salmon outline fragment on each and a few 2x2 logical-pixel coral flecks. Keep overall contrast restrained but visibly more defined than a nearly blank texture. Large flat shapes in #FBB699, subtle salmon #EE937F and base peach. No separate closed cell character or raised boulder.
